# The DoctorShield

> > The DoctorShield provides medical indemnity insurance solutions for healthcare professionals in Malaysia, powered by Chubb Elite Medical Malpractice Insurance and protected by PIDM's TIPS scheme.

The DoctorShield is a specialized insurance platform serving doctors and dentists in Malaysia with comprehensive medical malpractice coverage. The platform offers quote calculation, policy renewal, and claims management services integrated with Chubb Insurance Malaysia Berhad's Elite Medical Malpractice Insurance product.

- Medical Indemnity Insurance
- Medical Malpractice Insurance
- Chubb Elite
- Healthcare Professional Coverage
- Doctor and Dentist Insurance

- Malaysia
- Add-on Coverage
- First Notification of Loss
